description: Put a layout on one pane.

layout_id.description: The layout's id, as `observe.workspace` reports it.

name.description: The layout's name, as the strip shows it.

pane.description:
The pane's address (`0` the flow pane, `1..` the context stack).
Omitted: the focused pane — the pane the strip's own click switches.

tab_id.description: Which tab's pane changes layout. Omitted: the active tab.

title: SwitchLayoutTabInput
